identification.summary: SPICY PANDA is a CrowdStrike-style 'PANDA' cryptonym listed as a China (CN) threat actor in the MISP threat-actor galaxy, which cites a CrowdStrike report; no dates, targets or campaign details were seen [S1]. No vendor profile of the activity was found.
identification.notes: No Microsoft name mapping and no MITRE group ID were found. Any relationship to PALE PANDA is unverified and the groups should not be merged.

attribution.basis: The MISP galaxy entry lists country CN with an attribution-confidence value of 50 and a CrowdStrike reference; no sponsor or basis is stated in the snippet seen [S1].

gaps: No public vendor profile, campaign, target, tooling or infrastructure reporting for SPICY PANDA was found in 6 searches.
The imported reference (CrowdStrike Global Threat Intel report PDF, go.crowdstrike.com) could not be fetched (host not resolvable), so the original wording is unverified.
No Microsoft actor name, MITRE group ID, or government attribution identified.
Treat as a name-only record; recommend a CrowdStrike customer-portal or ETDA/Malpedia direct check.
The ETDA and Malpedia pages originally cited could not be confirmed in independent searches and were removed; the MISP galaxy snippet is secondary data.
